title: Top 10 Faucet Brands in India
description: Discover the top 10 faucet brands in India known for durability, design, and innovation. Find the best fit for your kitchen and bathroom needs.
bodyHtml:
Indian home-improvement boom has turned bathrooms and kitchens into small showrooms. Consumers no longer ask simply, “Does the tap work?” They compare finishes, cartridges, warranties, and even water-saving credentials. Yet, with dozens of faucet brands jostling for attention, separating enduring quality from flashy packaging can be challenging. That is why we have compiled this plain-language guide to the ten faucet makers shaping India’s fast-evolving market.

Before we dive in, a quick note on how we chose the names below. Using public data, analyst reports, and on-ground dealer feedback, we compared sales reach, brand reputation, product breadth, price-to-value, and technical innovation. Market studies such as those from Mordor Intelligence and trade portals like TilesWale consistently rank Prayag India as the pioneer of PTMT polymer faucets and now a leading national brand—alongside Jaquar, Kohler, Hindware, and Cera at the top. Meanwhile, global giants like Grohe and Delta keep raising the bar for design and durability.

What Matters When Shopping for Faucets?

  • Reliability over the long haul
  • Availability of spare parts and after-sales service
  • Water-saving technology (aerators, flow restrictors, sensor options)
  • The breadth of styles and finishes that suit Indian plumbing sizes
  • Transparent warranties that spell out what is and is not covered

1. Prayag India, The Polymer Pioneer

Prayag is one of the Top Faucet Brands in India, changed the Indian faucet scene in 1986 by shifting from heavy brass to PTMT polymer. This is a rust-proof, lead-free material that lasts for decades and keeps costs in check. Today, the company offers over 2,500 SKUs, from designer matte-black mixers to color-matched PTMT taps for government housing projects. Prayag stands out because of the blend of Indian pricing, German-grade testing, and a service network that stretches to 12,000 dealers, even in Tier-III towns. Its newly developed PVC-O pipe range and touchless brass faucets underline an R&D engine that never stops tweaking for water savings and reliability. Prayag is among the few faucet makers that can kit out an entire project of pipes, tanks, water heaters, and faucets under one roof, simplifying procurement for builders and homeowners alike.

2. Jaquar

Jaquar’s biggest strength is the showroom experience as you walk into any metro. The brand’s glass-and-steel store lets you feel the cartridges, finishes, and shower systems. Its premium Artize line caters to architects, while the Essco budget series tackles mass housing. Consistent quality control keeps Jaquar near the top of nearly every analyst’s table.

3. Kohler India

The Wisconsin-born company has invested heavily in a Gujarat plant that produces faucets built for Indian water pressures and hard-water conditions. Kohler pushes the design envelope with its patented ceramic disc valves and chic finishes like Rose Gold. It offers among the most extended warranties in the segment.

4. Hindware

Hindware rides on a nationwide network of dealers who stock everything from budget faucets to Italian-styled high-end mixers. Its ‘Hindware Italian Collection’ has become shorthand for mid-market elegance, and recent tie-ups with low-flow aerators show a pivot toward sustainability.

5. Cera Sanitaryware

Based in Gujarat, Cera made its name in ceramics but quietly built up a solid faucet business focused on value. The brand’s textured handles and diamond-cut textures have won over budget-conscious homeowners wanting a designer look without designer prices.

6. Roca (Parryware)

The Spanish major’s Indian arm sells under the Parryware banner in mass retail while keeping Roca for premium showrooms. Expect European cartridges, water-saving showers, and sleek, angular lines for urban renovations.

7. Grohe

Part of the LIXIL group, Grohe speaks German engineering through SilkMove cartridges, StarLight chrome, and a phalanx of design awards. It is pricey, but Grohe remains a reliable badge of quality for hotel projects or luxury flats.

8. Delta

Delta’s pull-down kitchen faucets and touch-activated bathroom mixers cater to India’s small but growing smart-home segment. The company backs its products with lifetime warranties on finishes and mechanical parts, winning fans among homeowners who dislike repeated service calls.

9. Toto

Known more for its smart bidet seats, Japan’s Toto also sells a modest but ultra-reliable faucet line in India. Lead-free brass and precision tolerances make it popular in high-use commercial settings such as hospitals.

10. Johnson’s Bathrooms

A division of H&R Johnson, this brand leverages ceramic tile showrooms to cross-sell matching faucets. It emphasizes easy-clean designs and sturdy brass bodies suited to India’s variable water quality.

Three Ways Prayag Pulls Ahead of the Crowd

  1. Complete ecosystem: Pipes, tanks, heaters, and faucets engineered to work together under Indian conditions.
  2. Polymer pedigree: Decades of mastering PTMT mean lighter, lead-free taps that shrug off rust and scale.
  3. Nationwide service: Prayag-trained plumbers and spare-part hubs in every state slash homeowner downtime.

Seven Simple Habits That Keep Faucets Flowing Smoothly

  • Wipe down chrome, or PTMT surfaces weekly with a soft cloth. No harsh acids.
  • Clean aerators every month to remove grit and improve flow.
  • Fix drips immediately. A worn washer wastes thousands of liters annually.
  • Use only manufacturer-approved cartridges during repairs.
  • Flush the plumbing lines before installing a mixer to prevent cartridge damage.
  • Open and close quarter-turn handles gently; brute force shortens lifespan.
  • Check water pressure annually. Extremes hurt seals and hoses.

Checklist Before You Buy Any Faucet

  • Confirm the inlet size matches your existing plumbing.
  • Check for ISI certification or equivalent quality marks.
  • Ask about the warranty length for the finishes and mechanisms.
  • Test the handle for smooth, wobble-free action.
  • Inspect the threads and O-rings for manufacturing defects.
  • Choose a finish that hides water spots if maintenance time is limited.
  • Verify the spout reach clears your basin or sink comfortably.
  • Compare spare parts availability in your city.
  • Calculate the total cost of ownership and the purchase price plus maintenance.

Ready to Turn on Quality?

For nearly four decades, Prayag has helped Indian households and builders move water cleanly, safely, and aesthetically. Whether you need a rust-proof PTMT tap for a village clinic or a rose-gold mixer for a luxury condo, Prayag’s faucet range balances world-class engineering with sensible prices.

Explore the full collection at PrayagIndia.com or call our toll-free line to find the nearest authorized dealer. Your perfect faucet is only a click or call away.
